constraints.text: The target contains no music, including copied background music.

description.text: A wide, completely empty railway station platform stretches across the frame under flat overhead lighting. Pale square floor tiles run toward the platform edge, where a darker safety strip marks the drop to the tracks. Slim metal pillars and a shallow canopy roof recede into the middle distance, and beyond them the tracks and the opposite platform sit in soft shadow. No passengers, staff, or other people appear anywhere in the scene. A single rectangular sign is mounted high on one pillar, its lettering the only readable text in the shot; the surface around it is plain and uncluttered. The air feels still, the space quiet and orderly, with small reflections on the tiled floor and the brushed metal of the sign frame. Nothing in the composition moves; the platform remains empty and undisturbed as the off-screen voice begins.
An empty station platform with tiled floor, pillars, and a single mounted sign.
Low, steady station room tone with a faint electrical hum.
The room tone continues quietly across the empty platform.

The shot cuts to a medium wide view along the same empty platform. An unmarked passenger train is already easing away from the platform edge, its carriage side sliding past the pillars before it draws clear of the canopy and recedes along the tracks. The motion is smooth and continuous, with the train shrinking steadily toward the far end of the station while the platform itself stays still and unoccupied. The tiled floor, safety strip, and metal pillars remain exactly as before, and no people enter the frame. No readable lettering is visible anywhere in this shot. Light glints briefly along the train windows and roofline as it departs, then the tracks and opposite platform settle back into plain view. The platform room tone persists beneath the fading sound of the train.
The unmarked passenger train pulls away from the platform and recedes along the tracks.
Train wheels and traction motors roll and begin to fade.
The train sound diminishes into the low platform room tone.

json.soundscape: Low station room tone with a faint electrical hum, joined in the second shot by the receding rumble of train wheels and traction motors that gradually fades into the quiet platform ambience.

speakers.description: An off-screen narrator, never visible in either shot.

claims.text: Two shots are requested: first an empty railway station platform, then a train departing.
A continuous off-screen voice begins the supplied line in the first shot and finishes it in the second.
Only the supplied sign text appears in the first shot, and no other dialogue or music is permitted.

summary.text: An empty railway station platform holds still, then cuts to an unmarked passenger train departing as the platform remains empty.
